summary_rationale: Mondelēz International earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health on a strictly price-blind basis. Its core moat rests on global category leadership in Biscuits & Baked Snacks (47.7% of FY2025 revenue; Oreo, Ritz, LU, Clif Bar) and Chocolate (32.9%; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka, Toblerone), generating $38.54 billion in FY2025 revenue across 150+ countries with no single customer exceeding 10% of sales and ~40% revenue exposure to higher-growth emerging markets (5M+ outlets in India, 1M+ stores in Brazil). Despite a historic 365% cocoa spike that compressed FY2025 GAAP gross margin by 1,070 bps to 28.4% and GAAP operating margin to 9.2%, cash generation remained resilient ($4.51B CFO, $3.24B FCF), and Q3 2026 demonstrated a clear operational inflection (+1.8 pp positive volume/mix, +380 bps YoY Adjusted Gross Margin expansion to 34.2%, and ~65% of revenue holding or gaining share). Watchpoints updated through Q3 2026 include: sluggish North American biscuit volumes, $64M in Q3 2026 biscuit brand intangible impairments and $115M 9M26 Europe restructuring, $43.37B of goodwill/intangibles (60.4% of Q3 2026 assets) capping headline ROIC, USMCA tariff exclusion in FY2026 guidance, lack of an ROIC/leverage metric in executive PSU incentives, and Net Debt reaching $20.12B at September 30, 2026 (with commercial paper up 38% to $3.61B) as 9M 2026 capital returns ($2.8B) exceeded 9M FCF ($1.66B).
